params.text: Single-ended class A at +/-18 V: the top compound pair (VT6, VT7, VT8) drives the load; the bottom one (VT9, VT10, VT11) is a 1.8 A current sink set by R15 and VT12.
Each half dissipates about 32 W at idle: TIP36C pairs on a heatsink of 0.4 K/W or better. The LED sets both the input-pair tail (VT3) and the VAS load (VT4).
RP1 trims the output offset to zero. Gain RF1/RF2 + 1 = 23 (27 dB); 14 W into 8 ohm at 1 % THD, all in class A.
